about.title: Our Mission
about.subtitle: An intelligent system to detect, alert, and protect against the Ebola virus in eastern DRC.

detection.title: Rapid Detection
detection.description: Our algorithm analyzes your symptoms in real-time to accurately identify potential signs of Ebola.

alert.title: Immediate Alert
alert.description: In case of high risk, health services are immediately notified for rapid intervention.

protection.title: Community Protection
protection.description: Track cases in your area, stay informed, and help protect your community.

about.imageCaption: Ebola screening response in Goma, DRC — 2019

symptomChecker.title: Check your symptoms
symptomChecker.subtitle: Answer the following questions to assess your risk. The system will analyze your answers confidentially.
symptomChecker.symptomDuration: How many days have you had these symptoms?
symptomChecker.contactInfected: Have you been in contact with a person infected with Ebola?
symptomChecker.contactAnimals: Have you been in contact with wild animals (bats, monkeys)?
symptomChecker.travelAffected: Have you traveled to an Ebola-affected area?

results.title: Analysis Result
results.lowMessage: Your symptoms do not strongly match the Ebola profile. Stay vigilant and see a doctor if symptoms persist.
results.moderateMessage: Some of your symptoms deserve medical attention. Visit a health center as soon as possible.
results.highMessage: Your symptoms match the Ebola profile. Contact health services immediately. Avoid all physical contact.
results.criticalMessage: EMERGENCY — Your symptoms indicate a very high risk of Ebola. Call the emergency number immediately. Do not move without medical assistance.

cta.title: Every minute counts
cta.subtitle: The Ebola virus spreads rapidly. Early detection saves lives. Don't wait.
cta.checkerDescription: Answer a few questions and get an immediate Ebola risk assessment based on your symptoms.
cta.variantWarning: Bundibugyo variant — fatality rate up to 50% · No vaccine · Early detection is essential.
cta.emergencySubtitle: If you or someone near you shows Ebola symptoms, contact health services immediately.

footer.aboutText: Surveillance and alert platform for eastern Congo communities facing the 2026 Ebola Bundibugyo epidemic.
footer.disclaimer: This service does not replace medical advice. In an emergency, call 101.
